childCopy.source: act => { const m = linkMenu; setLinkMenu(null); if (!m) return; if (act === 'open') onLink(m.href, false); else if (act === 'external') onLink(m.href, true); else if (act === 'copy-rel') setToast({ text: `已复制相对路径：${m.route.path}` }); else setToast({ text: `已复制：${m.route.url || projectRoot + '/' + m.route.path}` }); }

childStop.resolveSource: (cid, text) => { setChildResolved(r => ({ ...r, [cid]: true })); setToast({ text: text + ' · 合成' }); }
childStop.stateSource: c => childResolved[c.id] ? { ...c, state: 'running', live: '继续工作', approval: null } : c
